text:

It's going to be a busy November for Rockstar workers.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Messages in certain large public Discord servers will be searchable on the web after December
Discord is attempting to solve the 'this should've been a forum' problem with specially-designated channels whose messages can show up in search engines.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Mass Effect composer Sam Hulick is working on a 're-scored' version of the leaked Mass Effect 5 trailer for N7 Day
Hulick says he wants the trailer to properly represent his "musical vision" for the cancelled Mass Effect game.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Former Halo boss is now in charge of Wizards of the Coast and Hasbro Digital Games
Dan Ayoub joined WotC in 2024 and previously served as the company's SVP of digital games.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 review
This is what it looks like when Call of Duty is in the pocket.

author: PC Gamer
text:
After Onimusha's focused swordplay, Phantom Blade Zero delivers a sprawling, maximalist action epic
A truly enormous wuxia journey.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun studio announces major layoffs, then quickly deletes the announcement
Auroch Digital just released Boltgun 2 two weeks ago, and it's got Warhammer Survivors lined up for launch in November.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Nvidia and AMD invest billions into Meta as companies egg each other on to bet even more on AI
What's $3 billion to a trillion-dollar company?

author: PC Gamer
text:
Vote for the scariest game of all time: Round 1
Help whittle down a 16-game bracket to crown 'the scariest game on PC.'

author: PC Gamer
text:
Dungeons & Dragons: World of Warcraft's class designer 'crammed as much' of the MMO into it so that even veteran tabletop players can experience something new
The upcoming book introduces dozens of new subclasses, spells, and more to D&D's ruleset.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Square Enix vets say devs of the future will need to 'master the use of AI', but the human touch will still be vital
"Humans need to be involved in the initial step of turning zero into one."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Edge magazine went to Rockstar to see GTA 6, and will tell you all about it in lavish detail this Thursday, October 29
I bet you can steal cars.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Nvidia may not have discontinued the RTX 5090, but one AIB partner says it can't get hold of the parts required to make the card
And RTX 5090s weren't cheap before.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Deadline: Afterlife Processing lets you take morality into your own hands and judge who deserves eternal salvation or damnation
Playing music too loud on the subway? Believe it or not, straight to jail.

author: PC Gamer
text:
You just can't win—despite Ghost of Yōtei selling millions of copies, 24 people are reportedly being let go from Sucker Punch
Are the "challenges in the market" in the room with us right now?

author: PC Gamer
text:
Call of Duty passes $40 billion in lifetime revenue, making it one of the most lucrative videogame franchises ever
Never underestimate the unbridled love for yelling hoorah before gunning down the same generic bad guy every year.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Peter Molyneux speaks candidly about AI: 'We, as the industry, are pretending we're not using AI, but the reality is, it's almost impossible to code now without using AI'
The father of the god game weighs in on AI use in the gaming industry

author: PC Gamer
text:
Dark Messiah's new edition adds co-op, cut content and console-exclusive maps to the 20-year-old orc-kicking extravaganza, and it's coming to Steam this year
The Community Edition was created by fans and modders, with support from Ubisoft and Valve.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Kingdom Come, Lord of the Rings studio Warhorse 'hit by a cyberattack'
"This is a serious incident for Warhorse Studios and for everyone affected."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Bassist plays Halloween gig wearing a Steam Frame: 'Interestingly, only one guy asked me about the Frame'
Even wearing a VR headset couldn't get anyone to talk to the bassist.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Half-Life: Alyx patch adds foveated rendering support a mere 6 years after the game's release
Just took launching a VR headset with eye tracking for Valve to add it.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The 50 most-played Steam Next Fest demos include 7 incremental games, 4 AI disclosures, and only one instance of haystack slop
Ten years ago, this list would have shocked most PC gamers.

author: PC Gamer
text:
World of Warcraft: Forever's last-minute patch transforms its bovines into racecars capable of zooming 60% faster than everyone else
Blizzard dropped a final balance pass for each playable race's unique abilities.

author: PC Gamer
text:
One day before launch, ARPG Emberville gets delayed until 2027
Don't blame this one on GTA 6: The developers say incorporating feedback on Emberville's demo is taking longer than they expected.

author: PC Gamer
text:
A free 'micro' horror game from the maker of The Mortuary Assistant is basically if PT was an episode of Law and Order
Playable Archive is free, and it's very good.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The developer of one of my favorite 2020s RPGs does it because of BioWare: 'Baldur's Gate 1 is the first game I truly loved'
It's a hard one to beat.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Veteran game composer in talks to score Mass Effect 5 shares 20 minutes of music he wrote for the project: 'To even dream in your sandbox was a privilege'
We're so back / It's so over / We were so robbed.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The best haunted card game since Inscryption is back with a new mystery only solitaire freaks can solve

author: PC Gamer
text:
Walter Koenig, Star Trek's Pavel Chekhov, has died
Koenig gained fame as the Russian navigator of the USS Enterprise in the original Star Trek television series, films, and games.

author: PC Gamer
text:
